flatten_observations: flatten an observation dictionary into a single numpy array for reinforcement learning environments
flatten_observation_dim: compute the total flattened observation dimension from a dictionary of observation dimensions
flatten_observation_spaces: flatten a gym Dict observation space into a single gym.spaces.Box space
get_robot_base_position: get the base position of a robot object from a pybullet simulation environment
get_robot_base_orientation: get the base orientation quaternion of a robot object from a pybullet simulation environment
